parts:
Hi all,

I hope everything is going well for you. I have some questions and an issue. I am looking forward to your answers/suggestions/ideas.
Our sensor (DynaPort MM+) was placed on the back for 7 consecutive days. Frequency of accelerometer and temperature sensors were 100 and 1  Hz, respectively. My first question is: should I first resample the temperature data then merge acc data and temp ? My second question is: Should I put one csv file for 7 days of data collection for datadir?

I run the below code for one csv file that has temperature data already resampled and this csv file includes temp and acc data for 1 day.

library(GGIR)

GGIR(
  mode=c(1,2,3,4,5),
  datadir="C:../Pilot",
  outputdir="C:../Report",
  studyname= Pilot,
 
  #=====================
  # read.myacc.csv arguments
  #=====================
  Test <- read.myacc.csv ("C:../Pilot/M_d2.csv"),
  f0 = 0,
  f1 = 1,
  rmc.nrow = Inf,
  rmc.dec = ".",
  rmc.firstrow.acc = 2,
  rmc.col.acc = 2:4,
  rmc.col.temp = 5,
  rmc.col.time= 1,
  rmc.unit.acc = "g",
  rmc.unit.temp = "C",
  rmc.unit.time = "POSIX",
  rmc.format.time = "%s", #"%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%OS",
  #rmc.origin = "1970-01-01",
  rmc.desiredtz = "Europe/Berlin",
  #rmc.configtz = NULL,
  #rmc.desiredtz = NULL,
  rmc.sf = 100,

#-------------------------------
# Part 1 parameters:
#-------------------------------
windowsizes = c(5,900,3600),
do.cal = TRUE,
do.enmo = TRUE,
do.mad= TRUE,
do.en= TRUE,
#do.anglez = TRUE,
chunksize = 1,
printsummary = TRUE,
#-------------------------------
# Part 2 parameters:
#-------------------------------
strategy = 1,
ndayswindow = 7,
hrs.del.start = 0,
hrs.del.end = 0,
maxdur = 0,
includedaycrit = 16,
L5M5window = c(0,24),
M5L5res = 10,
winhr = c(5,10),
#qlevels = NULL,
qlevels = c(c(1380/1440),c(1395/1440),c(1410/1440),c(1420/1440),c(1425/1440),c(1430/1440),c(1435/1440)), #M60,M45,M30,M20,M15,M10,M5
qwindow = c(0,24),
#iglevels= NULL,
iglevels = c(seq(0,400,by=25),8000),
mvpathreshold = c(100,120),
#-------------------------------
# Part 3 parameters:
#-------------------------------
timethreshold = c(5,10),
#anglethreshold = 5,
ignorenonwear = TRUE,
#-------------------------------
# Part 4 parameters:
#-------------------------------
#excludefirstlast = FALSE,
includenightcrit = 16,
def.noc.sleep = 1,
loglocation = NULL,
outliers.only = FALSE,
criterror = 3,
relyonguider = FALSE,
#colid = 1,
#coln1 = 2,
do.visual = TRUE,
#-------------------------------
# Part 5 parameters:
#-------------------------------
# Key functions: Merging physical activity with sleep analyses
threshold.lig = c(30,40,50),
threshold.mod = c(100,120),
threshold.vig = c(400,500),
excludefirstlast = FALSE,
boutcriter = 0.8,
boutcriter.in = 0.9,
boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8,
boutdur.in = c(10,20,30),
boutdur.lig = c(1,5,10),
boutdur.mvpa = c(1,5,10),
timewindow = c("WW"),
#-----------------------------------
# Report generation
#-------------------------------
do.report = c(1,2,5))

I get this error:
Error in read.myacc.csv("C:../Pilot/M_d2.csv") : Timezone not specified, please provide at least desiredtz and consider specifying configtz.
 
Kind regards,
Hana

remotes::install_github("wadpac/GGIR")

best,
-Lena

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] question and  an error (Timezone not specified)
parts:
Dear Hananeh,

I see I have not replied to your question from October. Probably because you were going to take part in the training and I assumed we would discuss your questions then. Also you hinted at a collaboration but then it went silent.
My first question is: should I first resample the temperature data then merge acc data and temp ?
Yes, GGIR assumes that temperature is a column next to acceleration signals all with same resolution.
My second question is: Should I put one csv file for 7 days of data collection for datadir?
No, you can put multiple data files in datadir.

I get this error:
Error in read.myacc.csv("C:../Pilot/M_d2.csv") : Timezone not specified, please provide at least desiredtz and consider specifying configtz.

I hope that after having followed the GGIR training the error is now easier to understand. You will need to specify argument desiredtz and possibly configtz if the experiments took place in a different time zone then where the accelerometers were configured.

Best, Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
